item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las khro bo bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gzhung
item.coloph: ye shes gsas mkhar srid pa rab 'byams kyi rgyud las/ khro bo gshed dmar spyi 'dul zhes bya ba / gshen gsang ba 'dus pas/ dbal chen po gtso bo yab yum la lung nod nas/ bsnyen bsgrub gnyis ka'i gzhung don rgyas pa'i don du mdzad pa rdzogs so// phyi rabs kyi don du sdong dmu tsha'i bka' gter gnyis su gtan la phab cing bstan pa'o//
